The appointment returns Trafelet to the company’s top executive role after he resumed active leadership as Executive Chairman in late 2024. Since then, he has directed Hazeltree’s renewed emphasis on treasury management capabilities and its networked data platform, positioning the business to expand services for hedge funds, private equity firms and other institutional asset managers.

Trafelet originally developed Hazeltree within his alternative asset management firm, Trafelet Delta Funds, before spinning the company out as an independent business in 2011.
